svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1043 commits across five public projects, 73 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-12 through 2026-11-03 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-03T17:45:39.300Z.
